boundaries: Merge success does not establish runtime success.
Zero-step jobs are not execution evidence.
The latest refresh rechecks historical merge SHAs, not every current branch.
DOCX and Session Tuple blockers are retained from the earlier diagnostic pulse.
Lexical content counts are semantic proxies; the earlier PCA is a four-repo exploratory snapshot.
Read-only HTML/PDF and Excel views derive from this versioned register. Excel owns its visible numerical summary formulas; this JSON owns action identities, states and lineage.
Zod validates the delivery contract, not engineering truth or child acceptance.
